parameters.query:
WITH eligible_user AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.parqueadero_usuarios
  WHERE id = $1::bigint AND estado = 'ACTIVO'
), plate_conflict AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos
  WHERE UPPER(placa) = UPPER($2)
), primary_choice AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
      WHERE pv.parqueadero_usuario_id = $1::bigint AND pv.activo = TRUE
    ) THEN TRUE
    ELSE $7::boolean
  END AS is_primary
), demoted AS (
  UPDATE public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  SET es_principal = FALSE, actualizado_en = now()
  WHERE pv.parqueadero_usuario_id = $1::bigint
    AND pv.activo = TRUE
    AND pv.es_principal = TRUE
    AND (SELECT is_primary FROM primary_choice) = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_user)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict)
  RETURNING pv.id
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_vehiculos (
    parqueadero_usuario_id, placa, tipo_vehiculo, marca, modelo, color, es_principal, activo
  )
  SELECT eu.id, UPPER($2), $3, $4, $5, $6, pc.is_primary, TRUE
  FROM eligible_user eu
  CROSS JOIN primary_choice pc
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT count(*) FROM demoted) dependency
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict)
  RETURNING id, es_principal
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT TRUE FROM inserted LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS success,
  (SELECT id::int FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS id,
  (SELECT es_principal FROM inserted LIMIT 1) AS "isPrimary",
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_user) THEN 'El usuario no existe o está inhabilitado.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict) THEN 'La placa ingresada ya está registrada.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_user) THEN 404
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict) THEN 409
    ELSE 201
  END AS "statusCode";
